claims.text: Suicide bombings 1994–2005 killed 735 Israelis and wounded 4,554; ~116 attacks in the second intifada; Hamas ~43% of suicide attacks in its first 21 months; peak 2002, March 2002 alone 135 Israelis killed; Park Hotel Netanya Passover 2002, 30 killed.

Afula, 6 April 1994: 8 Israeli civilians killed; Hamas said it was retaliation for the 25 Feb 1994 Hebron mosque massacre of 29 worshippers by Baruch Goldstein; first Palestinian suicide attack on civilians inside Israel; Shin Bet adviser Matti Steinberg: Hamas had refrained from attacking civilians inside Israel before.
Hamas bombings: Dizengoff bus 19 Oct 1994 (22 killed); Dolphinarium 1 June 2001 (21); Sbarro 9 Aug 2001 (16, with PIJ).

Yassin killed 22 March 2004 by helicopter missiles after dawn prayers with nine bystanders; Sharon supervised (Israeli radio); Gillerman: 'When you kill our citizens, you will not be spared'; Straw: 'unacceptable, unjustified'; Rantisi killed weeks later.
HRW 2012 'Abusive System': arbitrary detention, torture, executions based on confessions obtained through torture, impunity in Hamas-run Gaza.
